import subprocess
# Use pdftotext to extract with page breaks
result = subprocess.run(['pdftotext', '-layout', 'main.pdf', '-'], capture_output=True, text=True)
text = result.stdout
pages = text.split('\f')
for i, page in enumerate(pages[:15], 1):
    # Find section headers on this page
    lines = page.strip().split('\n')
    headers = [l.strip() for l in lines if any(kw in l for kw in ['Introduction', 'Related Work', 'Method', 'Experiment', 'Discussion', 'Conclusion', 'Limitations', 'Ethics', 'Appendix', 'K ∗ -Aware', 'Filtering'])]
    if headers:
        print(f'Page {i}: {headers[:3]}')
    else:
        # show first non-empty line for context
        for l in lines:
            if l.strip() and len(l.strip()) > 10:
                print(f'Page {i}: [{l.strip()[:80]}]')
                break
" 2>&1
